description: Read what funding a campaign the caller's organization owns asks now, as the web app's funding page shows it. acceptedCount counts the people who accepted and are not yet funded. quote holds creatorPoolCents (compensation per creator times those people), priceCents (the campaign price by company size, on the campaign's first funding request only), and totalCents, the amount request_campaign_funding records; quote is null with no saved contract or no such person. fundRequest is the open funding request, or null. stepLabel names the step the web app shows next. A campaign of another organization reads as not found. Needs a credential.
name: get_campaign_funding
title: Get campaign funding
